## Quick answer

**Bahe Kurtiz** makes Jaipur hand block print kurta sets, kurtis, tunics and dresses in its own unit in **Sanganer, Jaipur** – the town best known for this craft. Every piece is available in sizes XS–3XL (4XL in linen & velvet styles) or stitched to your measurements for free, and ships with free duties-paid express delivery to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.

## Why Jaipur block print?

Jaipur – and especially Sanganer and nearby Bagru – has printed cloth by hand for centuries. A printer carves a motif into a wooden block, dips it in colour and stamps it onto the fabric, one impression at a time, lining up each repeat by eye. That is why a real hand block print has a soft, slightly uneven look that machine prints cannot copy.

| Print style | Look | Typical motifs |
|---|---|---|
| Sanganeri | Fine, delicate prints on a light background | Small florals, buttis, paisleys |
| Bagru | Earthier, bolder prints on darker grounds | Geometric and floral motifs |
| Dabu | Mud-resist printing, often dyed in indigo | Crackled, hand-resisted patterns |

Read more in our guide to [Sanganeri, Bagru and Dabu prints](/blog/sanganeri-bagru-and-dabu-print-a-simple-guide-to-jaipur-block-prints/).

## How to tell a real hand block print

- **Edges:** hand-stamped motifs have slightly soft edges; machine prints look razor-sharp.
- **Repeats:** look for tiny differences in pressure or alignment between repeats – a good sign, not a defect.
- **Back of the fabric:** hand-printed colour usually soaks further into the cloth.

Full guide: [hand block print vs screen print](/blog/hand-block-print-vs-screen-print-how-to-tell-the-difference/).

## Caring for block print

Wash in cold water, separately for the first few washes, with a mild detergent, and dry in the shade. Hand-printed cotton gets softer with every wash.

faq.q: Is Jaipur block print good quality?
faq.a: Good Jaipur block print is printed on breathable cotton or kota doria and stitched with care. Ours are made and checked in our own unit in Sanganer, Jaipur, and every piece can be stitched to your measurements.

faq.q: How can I tell if a kurta is really hand block printed?
faq.a: Look for slightly soft edges and small differences between repeats of the same motif. Machine prints look perfectly identical and razor-sharp.

faq.q: Will the block print colours fade?
faq.a: Wash in cold water separately for the first few washes and dry in the shade. Hand-printed cotton softens over time while keeping its colour.

faq.q: Do you ship Jaipur block print kurtas to the USA and UK?
faq.a: Yes – free express shipping with duties and taxes included to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, usually 5–10 business days after dispatch.

faq.q: Can I get a block print kurta set in my size?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a ready size from XS to 3XL (4XL in linen & velvet styles), or pick free custom fit and send your measurements – we stitch it for you.
